subject: AWS Marketplace metering + fulfillment: activation & entitlement handshake for Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Sujata Rao <sraj@amazon.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial AWS Marketplace metering/fulfillment checklist for Acme Analytics

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion, AWS Marketplace needs a few items confirmed before we can enable entitlement + metering for the Acme Analytics SaaS listing:

- Confirm the metering dimension name (e.g., redwood_tokens or acme_units).
- Provide fulfillment webhook URL and sample payload for activation/deactivation.
- Confirm the SaaS contract term that maps to entitlement activation (start date + term length).
- Upload a signed marketplace SaaS contract (DocuSign link preferred).
- Provide a contact for invoice disputes and billing reconciliation.

I'm attaching the marketplace fulfillment spec (attachment: redwood-saas-fulfillment-spec-v1.pdf) with example payloads and the file naming conventions for reports.

Can you confirm a timeline for the activation webhook and when you can share the entitlement mapping CSV? AWS typically needs those two items to validate the integration end-to-end.

Thanks,
Sujata
Marketplace Enablement – AWS ISV
Amazon Web Services

Attachments: redwood-saas-fulfillment-spec-v1.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sujata Rao <sraj@amazon.com>, Kyle Morris <kyle.morris@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial AWS Marketplace metering/fulfillment checklist for Acme Analytics

Hi Sujata (and Kyle),

Appreciate the checklist — copying our integration and billing leads so we can close this out quickly. High level plan from Redwood:

1) Metering dimension: we'll use "redwood_token_units" as the metering dimension to keep it unique across Acme SKUs.
2) Entitlement mapping: Soojin will prepare the CSV mapping external Acme SKUs -> marketplace entitlements and send it by EOD 14-Apr.
3) Fulfillment webhook: we'll host an activation endpoint behind our private provisioning service; sample payload and signing mechanism included in the attachment Soojin will share.
4) Contract: Acme legal asked for a final DocuSign package — Kyle, can you confirm who will route that?
5) Billing contact: Ben (cc) will be the billing point-of-contact for invoice reconciliation.

Requested dates: entitlement CSV by 2027-04-14, webhook staging endpoint by 2027-04-16, end-to-end validation test in staging on 2027-04-18. If that timeline works for AWS and Acme, we'll schedule a 30-minute validation call on 2027-04-18 10:00 PT.

Next steps for us:
- Soojin: prepare CSV + webhook sample.
- Ben: prepare billing contact details and invoice template.
- Marcus: coordinate DocuSign routing with Acme.

Thanks — Marcus
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Sujata Rao <sraj@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kyle Morris <kyle.morris@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Entitlement CSV + webhook sample (staging)

Marcus / Sujata — attaching the entitlement mapping and a minimal webhook sample for staging. See attachments: fulfillment-webhook-sample.json, acme-entitlement-mapping.csv.

Key notes (technical):
- CSV fields: marketplace_sku, internal_product_id, entitlement_id, activation_delay_seconds
- We set activation_delay_seconds=0 for immediate activation but can add a buffer per Acme request.
- Webhook: POST /api/marketplace/fulfillment/activate with HMAC header X-RW-Signature using the shared secret. Sample payload in attached JSON.
- Metering dimension in the payload: "redwood_token_units". Usage will be reported to AWS via our batch uploader every 10 minutes in staging, and every 1 minute in production (configurable).

Routing and infra: staging webhook URL (non-public): https://staging-provisioning.redwood.ai/marketplace/fulfillment
We will spin up a temporary test signing key and rotate after validation.

Testing plan:
- AWS sends an entitlement activation -> Redwood returns 200 + activation_id
- Redwood reports first usage delta within 10 minutes -> AWS receives metering event and matches entitlement_id
- For deactivation, AWS will call the same webhook with action=DEACTIVATE

I'm available for a technical dry run on 2027-04-16 — propose 09:00 PT.

Regards,
Soojin
Sr. Integrations Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: fulfillment-webhook-sample.json, acme-entitlement-mapping.csv
From: Kyle Morris <kyle.morris@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sujata Rao <sraj@amazon.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlement CSV + webhook sample (staging)

Thanks team — couple of procurement questions from Acme legal and billing:

- SLA: Can Redwood confirm marketplace-facing SLA for availability of the activation webhook? We need an availability objective to be listed in the Marketplace listing page.
- Invoice cadence: AWS will invoice Acme based on marketplace metering; what's Redwood's suggested reconciliation window for disputes? 30 days?
- Contract: I'll route DocuSign to our procurement lead today (expect signed by 2027-04-17). Any special clause we should expect from Redwood?

Ben — looping you for invoice contact and dispute flow details.

Kyle
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Acme Analytics

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kyle Morris <kyle.morris@acme-analytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sujata Rao <sraj@amazon.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlement CSV + webhook sample (staging)

Kyle — quick answers and next steps: 

- SLA: Redwood will commit to a marketplace webhook availability objective of 99.9% for production endpoints backed by our Dedicated tier; for the Marketplace listing we can include "high availability with 99.9% target" and provide uptime reporting via Redwood Console on request.
- Dispute window: standard suggested window is 45 days to allow for cross-checks between AWS usage events and our internal metering logs; we can accept 30 days if Acme requires it — recommend 45 by default.
- Billing contact: billing@redwood.ai (cc'ed to me). For disputes, please include the invoice id and measurement window; we'll provide event logs and the batched uploader manifests for reconciliation.

DocuSign: Marcus, if Acme sends the signed package by EOD 17-Apr, we'll finalize marketplace activation and proceed with the staging validation on 18-Apr.

Proposed runbook for the 18-Apr validation call:
- 10:00 PT: AWS triggers entitlement activation -> Redwood acknowledges
- 10:05 PT: Redwood posts first usage to AWS metering service (staging)
- 10:15 PT: Cross-check metering event match and entitlement_id mapping
- 10:25 PT: Trigger deactivation and confirm cleanup

I'll host the validation call and capture logs in a shared Drive (link will be posted to the deal in HubSpot).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: none inline (entitlement CSV already attached).
